title: Differential quality alarms for pinned model changes
creator: Maya Li
description:
Problem: model version pins (catalog or customer locks) can introduce subtle quality regressions that are not captured by coarse SLO signals. We need a lightweight, automatically-triggered evaluation and alarm system that compares pre-change and post-change quality metrics, surfaces statistically significant regressions, and ties to escalation automation (not immediate rollback) for tenant and catalog pin/upgrades.

Goal: implement 'differential quality alarms' that run targeted eval probes when a model version pin or catalog promotion occurs, compute delta metrics against the pinned baseline using effect-size and significance tests, and emit graded alerts (info/warning/critical) with tenant-aware thresholds and suggested remediation actions. Alerts should attach confidence, example failure prompts, and links to reproducible eval runs.

Success criteria: (1) For staged rollouts, >90% of regressions that matter to customers are surfaced before 1% production traffic sees the new model, (2) false-positive alarm rate below 8% across 2 weeks of canaries, (3) alerts include reproducible example list and a recommended response (rollback, rate-limit, manual review).
acceptance_criteria: Evaluations auto-trigger on catalog promotions and tenant pin updates within 2 minutes of the event
Delta computation compares configured metric sets (e.g., BLEU/ROUGE/semantic-similarity/AUPRC/custom-task-signal) to baseline with a configurable significance test
Alerts classified into informational / warning / critical with clear thresholds and sample prompts attached
Tenant-level throttling to avoid excessive eval costs; system honors budget and sampling policy per tenant
Dashboard row and a one-click link to rerun the probe with larger sample size
Integration hooks for automated escalation (Slack/webhook) and a manual rollback suggestion in Console
comments: 2026-02-10 Maya Li: Initial spec drafted after customer incident where a pinned upgrade reduced suggestion quality for a major tenant. Linking to incident notes: https://drive.google.com/incident/pin-regression-2026-01

2026-02-18 Eng sync: Connor, Priya, and runtime team reviewed feasibility. Key trade-offs: (a) run full synthetic suite vs. targeted lightweight probes; (b) sampling budget vs. detection sensitivity. Decision: start with targeted probes plus an on-demand full evaluation run for high severity alarms.

2026-02-22 Engineering assessment: ENG-42177 referenced for eval dispatch fabric. Estimated infra effort 3 sprints to add delta-stats and webhook plumbing. Connor noted need for a new 'eval-job' type that stores pre-change baselines for quick comparison.

2026-02-28 Design/UX: Console row mockups created (link: https://figma.com/file/pin-quality-alarms). Mockups include alert severity badges, sample prompt carousel, and 'rerun with n=500' quick action.

2026-03-03 Security review: no new data exfiltration risk; evaluations run on synthetic prompts and sampled tenant prompts only if tenant opt-in. KMS usage required for storing sample hashes — raised to Security for confirmation.

2026-03-08 PM note: Added tenant budget guard requirement after discussion with finance (avoid runaway eval cost for small tenants). Budget defaults: free tier 100 eval calls per pin; paid tiers configurable.
2026-03-10 Eng update: Prototype Lambda-based probe runner implemented in feature branch: github.com/redwood/inference/pin-eval-probes PR#4125. Next: add delta statistical layer and Console wiring.
